# meshoptimizer

Unmodified MIT-licensed sources from https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer,
version 1.3, commit `9e1f07b159d3cb777f1c67ed31fc11fd117986f4`.

Archive: https://codeload.github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer/tar.gz/9e1f07b159d3cb777f1c67ed31fc11fd117986f4

SHA-256: `e753b45fbc410031bd69cb278180ae31fa0d5430d0c3e662e3a3b100467ce0b3`.

Only the header, allocator, index generator, simplifier, vertex-cache optimizer,
vertex-fetch optimizer and license are included. Linked into the project-local
native core, not installed system-wide. Remove the sources and corresponding
core CMake references together to remove this dependency.
